title: Effective of Early Treatment of Insomnia on the Adherence of CPAP

sections.abstract: This study includes patients suffering from both sleep apnea and insomnia. All participants receive treatment with CPAP. Half of the participants additionally receive a digital program to treat insomnia, initiated at the same time as CPAP. The other half follows usual care and will be able to access the program after 6 months. The aim is to determine whether treating insomnia earlier improves CPAP use and overall health.
